# Shayan Movers and Packers

> Moving company serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah and Al Ain. House, villa and office moving, packing, furniture dismantling, storage and inter-emirate moves. Phone and WhatsApp: +971 54 732 6816.
